div.div: أَخَذَهُ بِظَلِيفَتِهِ , (S, M, O, L,) or ↓ بِظَلِيفِهِ , (K,) and ↓ بِظَلَفِهِ , (S, O, K,) ↓ بِظَلِفَتِهِ , (T, M, L,) He took it altogether, or wholly, (T, * S, O, K,) or with its root, or base, and wholly, (M, L,) not leaving of it anything: (T, S, M, O, L, K:) so says AZ. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
